description: This reference locates solenoid-valve no auxiliary contact in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented solenoids family. This form identifies a normally-open auxiliary contact associated with a solenoid valve. The public library uses HSV21 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.
